Summary: The ManuRAG1-4 models show varying degrees of performance in factual correctness, semantic similarity, context precision, context recall, and ROUGE scores. Specifically, ManuRAG4 achieves the highest factual correctness at 62.03% and semantic similarity at 87.82% in MathQ, while ManuRAG1 scores 19.14% in factual correctness and 77.03% in semantic similarity. In context-based performance, ManuRAG4 leads with 86.84% context precision and 81.56% context recall in RQ. The ROUGE scores for ManuRAG4 is 86.77%, the highest among the ManuRAG models.
